referenceFidelity.findings: The same forest tree family now uses the current park terrain with the shared .54 m muted neutral transition, replacing the outdated wide blue separator.

construction.findings: Top, isometric and reverse views show crowns within the tile, grounded tree trunks and a clear cave footprint. Forty-two trees retain irregular seeded placement. Runtime uses two meshes and packed textures.

readability.findings: Grass reaches the narrow perimeter transition. Forest-to-hill join reads continuously in campus composition; tree scatter leaves the cave mouth and promenade visible.

motion.findings: Static asset; no motion clips in the contract.

secondPass.findings: After replacing the older park snapshot, rechecked top and reverse exports: the old broad band is absent, six edge interfaces are unchanged and no crowns occupy the reserved cave space.

userAcceptance.note: Awaiting user artistic review of this revision.

limitations: Static environmental artwork; no gameplay interactions.
